sources.fullCitation: “Ein Lied für Dich.” Sheet-music cover for the 1933 film, with Jan Kiepura; texts by Ernst Marischka and Fritz Rotter, music by Walter Jurmann and B. Kaper. Wiener Bohème Verlag, Berlin–Vienna; cover design signed “Herzig”. Digital reproduction: Verein der Freunde und Förderer des Werks von Walter Jurmann, official cover gallery.

media.title: Ein Lied für Dich (1933) — promotional sheet-music cover
media.description: Cover of the Wiener Bohème Verlag song edition for Ein Lied für Dich (1933), “ein Cine-Allianz Joe May-Film der Ufa,” with Jan Kiepura: texts by Ernst Marischka and Fritz Rotter, music by Walter Jurmann and B. Kaper. Design signed Herzig.
media.altText: Vintage promotional sheet-music cover for “Ein Lied für Dich,” featuring Jan Kiepura and Jenny Jugo.
media.rightsNote: The Walter Jurmann cover gallery documents this German promotional cover but supplies no open reuse licence. A graphic work published in Germany in 1933 remained protected on 1 January 1996, so United States copyright was restored under the URAA. The local image is classified as restricted.
